ads.purpose: Generate qualified aerospace parts sourcing inquiries
ads.intro: Hard-to-find aviation parts? Start with SAIF. Share your part number and requirements to begin a sourcing inquiry.
ads.headline: Find your next aerospace sourcing partner
ads.description: Surplus military and aviation parts sourcing.
ads.alternateIntro: Have a part number? Bring it to SAIF. Start a conversation about your aviation parts sourcing requirements.
ads.alt: Conceptual natural-light aerospace components on a workbench with SAIF branding. AI-generated imagery, not actual verified inventory.
ads.target: U.S. aviation maintenance and repair businesses, aerospace parts distributors, and relevant procurement teams. Suggested role families: purchasing, procurement, supply chain, and operations. Validate inventory fit with SAIF first.
ads.success: Qualified sourcing inquiries containing a company, part number, quantity, and usable contact details. Track quote progression separately.
ads.visualNote: Built-in AI-generated conceptual imagery; disclosure appears on the creative.

ads.purpose: Introduce the company and encourage informed business conversations
ads.intro: Meet the business behind aerospace parts sourcing. Explore SAIF Industries, a family-owned supplier established in 1999.
ads.headline: Explore SAIF's aerospace supply business
ads.description: Company history, capabilities, and operating footprint.
ads.alternateIntro: Aerospace supply starts with an operating business. Get to know SAIF Industries and its parts sourcing capabilities.
ads.alternateHeadline: Get to know the business behind the parts
ads.alt: SAIF's own aerial facility photograph with its history, inventory scale, and facility size in a restrained green and cream layout.
ads.target: U.S. aerospace and industrial strategic partners, corporate development teams, and investment professionals with a relevant sector focus. Build a researched list of relevant firms before selecting available role and company filters.
ads.success: Relevant company-profile visits followed by qualified investor or strategic-partner conversations. Do not count clicks as investment commitments.
ads.visualNote: SAIF website photograph with original typography. Public facts are attributed in the strategy. No investment offer or fundraising status is asserted.
